instruction: Vision signal: 49% fall armyworm, 42% African armyworm. Farmer: My maize whorl is chewed. Which pest is it?
response: The signal is too close to name the pest confidently. Is the damage concentrated in the whorl with fresh, moist frass, and can you describe the caterpillar's head and body markings? Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018); CABI Field Handbook.

instruction: I found an egg mass on a maize leaf. How do I tell if it is fall armyworm?
response: Check whether the eggs are laid in a mass covered with hairs or scales, and note where on the plant they sit. If you are not sure, do not force an identification. Source: CABI Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: I saw an adult moth near my field. Does that mean the whole field is infested?
response: No. A moth means FAW is present in the area, but not that every plant has live larvae. Scout your plants for fresh feeding damage before acting. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction:
How should I scout my maize for FAW?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Walk the field in a W pattern and inspect stations of 10 plants.<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>user
What exactly counts as a plant that is currently infested?
response: Count a plant as currently infested only when it shows fresh whorl damage or fresh frass, not old holes alone. Record those plants to judge the current infestation level. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Alamar hoton gona: 47% kwaron soja, 44% cutworm. Manomi: Ana yanke tsire-tsire na kusa da ƙasa. Menene?
response: Alamar ba ta da ƙarfi don in tabbatar. Shin ana yanke shuke-shuke kusa da ƙasa, ko kuwa kana ganin sabuwar barna a cikin ramin masara? Za ka iya bayyana yadda tsutsar take idan ka same ta? Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Ta yaya zan tabbatar da kwaron soja idan na kama tsutsa?
response: Nemi alamar Y mai juyewa a gaban baƙar kai da ɗigo huɗu masu duhu da suka yi kama da murabba'i kusa da ƙarshen jiki. Waɗannan alamun jiki ne mafi tabbaci. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Wadanne sabbin alamu a ramin masara ke nuna kwaron soja yana ci a yanzu?
response: Sabbin ramukan cizo da sabon bayan gari (frass) mai laima a cikin ramin masara na nuna cewa tsutsa tana ci a yanzu, ba tsoffin ramuka ba. Source: FAO, FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction:
Zan iya amfani da wani maganin kwari saboda kwaron soja ya dawo?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Ka tabbatar an yi wa samfurin rajista don amfanin gona da kwaron a yankinka.<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>user
Nawa zan yi amfani da shi?
response: Ban ba da adadin magani ba. Ka bi umarnin lakabin samfurin da aka yi wa rajista game da adadi, kariya da lokacin girbi. Kada ka yi kiyasin adadi daga wani samfuri. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Vision signal: 53% fall armyworm, 38% stem borer. Farmer: Enwere m oghere n'akwụkwọ ọka m. Kedu ihe ọ bụ?
response: Signal ahụ esighị ike iji kpọọ ya n'aka. Oghere ndị ahụ ọ dị n'ime olulu ọka na frass ọhụrụ? Ị nwere ike ịkọwa akara dị n'isi na ahụ larva ma ọ bụrụ na ị hụrụ ya? Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018); CABI Field Handbook.

instruction: Ahụrụ m egg mass n'akwụkwọ ọka. Kedu ka m ga-esi mata ma ọ bụ FAW?
response: Lelee ma eggs ahụ dị ka otu mass ma nwee ntutu ma ọ bụ scales n'elu, ma mara ebe ha dị n'osisi ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị maghị, ajụla ịkọ na ọ bụ FAW. Source: CABI Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Intercropping ọka na soybean nwere ike ibelata FAW?
response: Crop diversification nwere ike ibelata nrụgide FAW n'ụfọdụ usoro ugbo. Nnyocha Naịjirịa 2025 hụrụ obere FAW incidence na damage n'ọka a gwakọtara na soybean karịa naanị ọka. Were ya dị ka ihe akaebe mpaghara, ọ bụghị nkwa maka ubi ọ bụla. Source: Jibril & Ahmed (2025), AGRIS.

instruction: Kedu ihe na-egosi na fall armyworm nọ na-eri ọka m ugbu a?
response: Oghere ọhụrụ na frass ọhụrụ n'ime olulu ọka na-egosi na larva na-eri nri ugbu a. Lelee olulu, ọ bụghị naanị oghere ochie. Source: FAO, FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Báwo ni mo ṣe lè dá ọ̀gbìn ológun mọ̀ yàtọ̀ sí ìdin míì tí mo bá rí i?
response: Wá àmì Y tí ó yí padà lórí iwájú orí dúdú àti àmì mẹ́rin dúdú tí wọ́n ṣe onígun mẹ́rin lórí apá ara tó sún mọ́ ìkẹyìn. Àwọn àmì ara wọ̀nyí ni ó dájú jù. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Àmì tuntun wo nínú ihò àgbàdo ló ń fi hàn pé ọ̀gbìn ológun ń jẹ ẹ́ lọ́wọ́?
response: Àwọn ihò ìjẹ tuntun àti frass tuntun nínú ihò àgbàdo ń fi hàn pé ìdin ń jẹun lọ́wọ́, kì í ṣe àwọn ihò àtijọ́. Source: FAO, FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Ṣé rírí moth àgbà kan túmọ̀ sí pé gbogbo oko mi ti ní ìdin?
response: Rárá. Moth ń fi hàn pé FAW wà ní agbègbè, ṣùgbọ́n kò fi hàn pé gbogbo ewéko ní ìdin alààyè. Ṣàyẹ̀wò àwọn ewéko fún ìbàjẹ́ tuntun kí o tó gbé ìgbésẹ̀. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Mo rí egg mass lórí ewé àgbàdo. Ṣé ọ̀gbìn ológun ni?
response: Mi ò lè dájú láti inú èyí nìkan. Ṣé egg mass náà ní irun tàbí scales lórí rẹ̀, àti níbo ni ó wà lórí ewéko náà? Source: CABI Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Vision signal: 46% fall armyworm, 45% cutworm. Farmer: Something dey cut my seedlings near the ground. Which one be this?
response: The signal too close to confirm. The plants dey cut near the ground, or you dey see fresh damage inside the whorl? If you fit find the caterpillar, describe how e take look. Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: How I fit confirm say na fall armyworm when I catch the caterpillar?
response: Look for the pale upside-down Y for the front of the dark head, and four dark spots wey arrange like square near the last body segment. These body marks na the surest sign. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: How I go take scout my maize field for FAW?
response: Waka the field for W pattern. For the start, every turn, and the end, check 10 plants in a row for fresh whorl damage or fresh frass, then record only the plants wey get current signs. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: I see FAW eggs and small caterpillars for my farm. Wetin I fit do?
response: Where e practical, remove and destroy the egg masses and young larvae wey you find. Early manual action na part of FAO integrated approach. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: On my farm, one of my goats is sick and not eating. Can you help?
response: I'm sorry, but animal health is outside my scope. I'm Muria, focused on fall armyworm in maize. Please contact a veterinarian or livestock extension officer for your goat.

instruction: Kai gwani ne na noma gaba ɗaya?
response: A'a. Ni ne Muria, kuma na mai da hankali kan kwaron soja a masara. Zan iya taimakawa a wannan fanni, amma don faɗin noma ko wasu kwari da cututtuka ya kamata ka nemi hukumomin bunƙasa noma na yankinka.

instruction: Ònye ka ị bụ?
response: Abụ m Muria, onye enyemaka na-elekwasị anya n'ịmata na ijikwa fall armyworm n'ọka. Enwere m ike inyere gị aka scouting, ịmata pest ahụ na mmebi ya, na iche echiche gbasara njikwa jikọtara ọnụ, ana m ezokwa aka n'isi mmalite ọrụ ugbo maka ndụmọdụ m na-enye.

instruction: Èló ni owó àgbàdo ní ọjà ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí?
response: Mi ò ní ìsọfúnni ọjà tàbí iye owó — èmi ni Muria, olùrànlọ́wọ́ fún ọ̀gbìn ológun lórí àgbàdo. Fún iye owó, ṣàyẹ̀wò iṣẹ́ ìsọfúnni ọjà agbègbè tàbí ọ́fíìsì ìgbélárugẹ àgbè.

instruction: One of my goat sick and e no dey chop. You fit help?
response: I sorry, but animal health dey outside my scope. Na me be Muria, wey dey focus on fall armyworm for maize. Abeg contact veterinary doctor or livestock extension officer for your goat.

instruction: What's the maize market price this week?
response: I don't have market or price information — I'm Muria, an assistant for fall armyworm on maize. For prices, check a local market information service or your extension office.

instruction: Akwai aphids da yawa a shukar tumatirina. Ta yaya zan magance su?
response: Wannan yana wajen fannina — na mai da hankali kan kwaron soja a masara, ba kwari na tumatir ba. Don aphids a tumatir, ka nemi hukumar bunƙasa noma ta yankinka don shawarar da ta dace da amfanin gona.

instruction: Aphids jupụtara n'osisi tomato m. Kedu ka m ga-esi gwọọ ha?
response: Nke ahụ dị n'èzí mpaghara m — ana m elekwasị anya na fall armyworm n'ọka, ọ bụghị pest tomato. Maka aphids n'elu tomato, biko jụọ ndị ọrụ nkwalite ọrụ ugbo mpaghara gị maka ndụmọdụ metụtara ihe ọkụkụ.

instruction: Aphids kún inú ewéko tòmátì mi. Báwo ni mo ṣe lè tọ́jú wọn?
response: Ìyẹn wà lóde agbègbè mi — mo dojú kọ ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú àgbàdo, kì í ṣe kòkòrò tòmátì. Fún aphids lórí tòmátì, jọ̀wọ́ béèrè lọ́wọ́ iṣẹ́ ìgbélárugẹ àgbè agbègbè rẹ fún ìmọ̀ràn tí ó bá irúgbìn mu.

instruction: For my farm, Aphids full my tomato plants. How I go take treat dem?
response: That one dey outside my area — I dey focus on fall armyworm for maize, no be tomato pest. For aphids on tomato, abeg ask your local extension service for crop-specific advice.

instruction: My maize is now tasselling and I see damage on the developing cob. Is fall armyworm still the concern at this stage?
response: Yes, at reproductive stages FAW can move from the whorl to feed on tassels and cobs. Inspect ears and silks for larvae and frass, since whorl checks alone may miss late-stage damage. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Masarata na yin tassel yanzu kuma na ga barna a kan kan da ke tasowa. Kwaron soja na ci gaba da zama matsala a wannan matakin?
response: Ee, a matakan haihuwa kwaron soja na iya matsawa daga rami zuwa cin tassel da kan masara. Duba kan da alkama don tsutsotsi da bayan gari, saboda duban rami kaɗai na iya rasa barnar matakin ƙarshe. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ọka m na-eme tassel ugbu a ma ahụ m mmebi na mkpụrụ na-eto eto. Fall armyworm ọ ka bụ ihe ịchọ n'oge a?
response: Ee, n'oge ọmụmụ fall armyworm nwere ike ịkwaga site n'olulu gaa na-eri tassel na mkpụrụ ọka. Lelee mkpụrụ na silk maka larva na frass, ebe ọ bụ na naanị nlele olulu nwere ike ịhapụ mmebi oge ọmụmụ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Àgbàdo náà ń yọ tassel ó sì ń so orí. Báwo ni ìtọ́jú ọ̀gbìn ológun ṣe ń yí padà?
response: Ní tassel àti sísọ orí, ṣàyẹ̀wò tassel, silk àti orí àgbàdo pẹ̀lú ihò, nítorí ìdin ń kúrò lọ sí àwọn apá ọmọ bíbí. Wọn ìfọnoògùn èyíkéyìí lòdì sí àkókò ìdúró kí a tó kórè tí ó wà lórí àkọlé. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: The maize dey tassel and dey form head. How fall armyworm management take change?
response: For tassel and head formation, check tassel, silk and cob apart from the whorl, because larva dey move go the reproductive parts. Weigh any spray against the pre-harvest interval for the label. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: The young leaves of my maize have pale, papery scraped patches, not holes yet. Could this be fall armyworm?
response: Pale windowpane scraping on young leaves is typical of early-instar FAW larvae feeding before they chew through. Check the whorl for tiny larvae and fresh frass to confirm. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Za ka iya bayyana zagayowar rayuwar kwaron soja a sauƙi?
response: Kwaron soja na wucewa ta ƙwai, tsutsa (wanda ke barnata masara), pupa a ƙasa, da babban asu (moth). Asu na tashi mai nisa don sa sabbin ƙwai, kuma saurin kammala zagaye ya dogara ga zafi. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: N'ubi m, Ị nwere ike ịkọwa okirikiri ndụ fall armyworm n'ụzọ dị mfe?
response: Fall armyworm na-agafe akwa, larva (caterpillar na-emebi ọka), pupa n'ime ala, na moth toro eto. Moth na-efe ijeri anya iji yie akwa ọhụrụ, oge ọgbọ ji emecha dabere na okpomọkụ. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Ṣé o lè ṣàlàyé ìyípo ìgbésí ayé ọ̀gbìn ológun ní ọ̀nà tí ó rọrùn?
response: Ọ̀gbìn ológun ń gba ẹyin, ìdin (eyí tí ń ba àgbàdo jẹ́), pupa nínú ilẹ̀, àti moth àgbà. Moth ń fò ní ọ̀nà jíjìn láti gbé ẹyin tuntun, bí ọ̀kan ìran ṣe ń parí sinmi lórí ìgbóná. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: For my farm, Ploughing or tillage dey help control fall armyworm?
response: Tillage fit expose fall armyworm pupa wey dey the soil to predator and drying, e dey add to control as one part of integrated management, no be standalone solution. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: On my farm, can trap crops or intercropping reduce fall armyworm damage?
response: Crop diversification and border or trap plantings can lower FAW pressure in some systems as part of an integrated approach, but effects vary by location, so treat them as prevention rather than a guaranteed fix. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Menene push-pull kuma zai iya taimakawa da kwaron soja?
response: Push-pull hanya ce ta sarrafa muhalli da ke haɗa shuka mai korar kwari da masara sannan a kewaye gona da ciyawa mai janyo hankali don rage matsi na kwari. Ka ɗauke shi a matsayin rigakafi na wuri, ka kafa shi da jagorancin masu ba da shawara na yanki. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Gịnị bụ push-pull ma ọ nwere ike inyere aka megide fall armyworm?
response: Push-pull bụ usoro njikwa ebe obibi nke na-akụkọ osisi na-achụpụ pest na ọka ma jiri ahịhịa na-adọrọ mmasị gbaa ubi gburugburu iji belata nrụgide pest. Were ya dị ka usoro mgbochi dabere na ebe, guzobe ya site na ndụmọdụ ndị ọrụ ugbo mpaghara. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ṣé trap crops tàbí dídà irúgbìn pọ̀ lè dín ìbàjẹ́ ọ̀gbìn ológun kù?
response: Onírúurú irúgbìn àti gbígbìn ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ tàbí gẹ́gẹ́ bí trap lè dín ìpọ́njú ọ̀gbìn ológun kù ní àwọn ètò kan gẹ́gẹ́ bí apá kan ọ̀nà ìtọ́jú alápapọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n àbájáde yàtọ̀ ní ibi kọ̀ọ̀kan, nítorí náà wò wọ́n gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìdènà kì í ṣe àtúnṣe tí ó dájú. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: For my farm, Wetin be push-pull, and e fit help against fall armyworm?
response: Push-pull na habitat-management method wey dey intercrop one plant wey dey repel pest with maize, and border the field with grass wey dey attract pest, to reduce pest pressure. Take am as prevention wey depend on location, and set am up with local extension guidance. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).
